2.msg: What's wrong? What happened? Are you lost?

3.msg: ...Well, well, those big monsters, it was those big monsters!

4.msg: Those big monsters are bothering you, right? No need to cry, take your time.

5.msg: *Sob* Yep, right. Like, they like took this #btreasure I was hiding#k, like this.

6.msg: Really? What punks! I'll teach them a lesson. Point me at 'em! I'll take on #b200#k of them!

7.msg: The big monsters that were bothering me are the #b#o9101025##k of #b#h0##k. They're super strong. Will you still punish them for me? Really? Really really? Remember, a #e#o9101025##n is between #r#e10 levels below and 20 levels above your own#k#n. So, if you're Lv. 50, the Lv. 40-70 monsters will be #e#o9101025##n. However, if your level is above Lv. 150, all monsters Lv. 150 or higher will be considered #e#o9101025##n!

yes.0: All right! If you punish those big monsters for me, I can give you some of the #btreasure I was hiding#k, #b#h0##k!
yes.1: Every day before you start the punishing, click the #e<Challenge>#n in the Attendance Log inside the star-shaped notification on the left side of the screen. Then you'll be all set to punish!
yes.2: #b#h0##k, I'm gonna write your name down as the hero who helped me! Also so I can remember I gave you a gift!
yes.3: Okie! You have to remember the Attendance Log in the star-shaped notification on the left side of the screen, okay? Good luck!
